title: backend orchestration project config
description: Project-owned provider profiles and role assignment plans for the optional backend-orchestration capability. This contract is separate from .harness/project.json and does not contain credentials.

$schema.description: Editor-facing pointer to this schema; the harness does not read it to resolve the config.

provider_profiles.description: Named project-owned provider profiles. Profile IDs are referenced by ordered assignment plans.

assignment_plans.description: Role plans with an explicit runtime-specific profile, model, and reasoning effort.

backend_zones.description: Named write/read boundaries referenced by assignment plans.

concurrency_budget.description: Maximum number of coordinator-approved active batches.

verification_commands.description: Project commands a coordinator requires as orchestration proof.

developer_verification_commands.description: Optional focused commands for a developer work dispatch. When omitted, verification_commands remains the backward-compatible developer and clean-room QA list.

test_path_patterns.description: Optional fnmatch-style glob patterns identifying this project's test files, used to gate delta-review eligibility for a test-only fix after a code-review Warning. Defaults to a Python/pytest convention (tests/**, **/tests/**, **/test_*.py, **/*_test.py) when omitted.

approval_policy.description: Human approval cadence. manual_all approves every transition; milestone keeps plan, risk/scope, QA and publish gates; low_risk is restricted to explicitly approved low-risk zones.

human_approval_gate.description: How an explicit human approval is proven. trusted accepts --approved-by/--approved-at as authored by the operator; tty additionally requires a confirmation typed on the real terminal, which a non-interactive agent session cannot produce, so a coordinator session cannot advance a gate on its own.

low_risk_zones.description: Explicitly pre-approved zones eligible for low_risk continuation; omitted means no zone is eligible.

worker_attestation_required.description: Require each runtime worker to attest its canonical Git worktree, branch and pinned commit before a completion report is accepted. New projects should keep this enabled; omitted keeps legacy projects compatible.

agent_to_agent_language.description: Language for agent-to-agent handoffs, state evidence and internal protocol text.

coordinator_report_language.description: Language for completion reports and summaries addressed to the coordinator.

adaptive_continuation_policy.description: Optional thresholds a planned-trigger `dispatch resume` continuation must meet. Any field left out keeps the coordinator's documented default.

context_limit.description: Minimum --measured-value for a context-limit planned trigger. Default 150000.

tdd_cycle_count.description: Minimum --measured-value for a tdd-cycles planned trigger. Default 3.

failure_log_bytes.description: Minimum --measured-value for a failure-log planned trigger. Default 20000.

context_warn_ratio.description: Share of context_limit at which record_telemetry/dispatch_status's context_advisory reaches level warn. Default 0.8.

tool_policy.description: Optional override of the allowed_tools list each dispatch brief records. A role's own entry wins over its mode's entry, which wins over the built-in default for that mode (read-only: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash; write: those plus Edit, Write). The list is the role's working set recorded in the brief; it never disables the runtime's global tools.

modes.description: Tools for every role of a manifest mode.

roles.description: Tools for one role, keyed by its manifest name; each name must match a role manifest.

context_package_policy.description: Token-aware Context Package admission limits. The package must fit within the configured context window after reserving prompt headroom.

symbol_graph_depth.description: Import-graph traversal depth from a Context Package's starting files. Applies to every automatic package (architect/developer/code-review dispatch creation) as well as a manual `context-package register`; `--symbol-graph-depth` on the latter overrides it for that package only.

max_related_tests.description: Fail-loud circuit breaker: a Context Package whose related_tests (tests that import a starting file) exceed this count raises ContextPackageError instead of silently including all of them. `--max-related-tests` on `context-package register` overrides it for that package only.

repo_map_policy.description: Optional enterprise policy for the portable Repo Map CLI. All paths are repository-relative globs; redact_paths excludes both the path and its source from output.

continuation_policy.description: Maximum worker-session continuations per dispatch, including provider rate-limit resumes.

retry_policy.description: Maximum new developer attempts after review or QA asks for a retry.

attention_policy.description: When a batch is flagged needs_attention -- a batch-level flag, not a lifecycle state. While it is set no next dispatch is created; evidence and the candidate are never touched. A human clears it with `batch attention resolve`. Any field left out keeps its default; the resolved values are frozen into every brief as orchestration_policy.attention.

retry_queue_seconds.description: How long a decided retry may wait for its next dispatch before the batch needs attention.

max_infrastructure_retries.description: Operational retries (verification-infrastructure, transport, context-pressure) tolerated for one candidate; one more needs attention.

stale_dispatch_seconds.description: Silence after which a live dispatch is stale and the batch needs attention.

approval_ttl_seconds.description: How long an explicit --approved-at stays valid. An older, or future-dated, approval is rejected and never reused. Absent means an approval does not expire.

extensions.description: Pluggable operational interfaces kept out of the coordinator core. Each value is 'none' (the default, inert), a name a host registered, or 'module:factory' naming a zero-argument factory in an importable module. The selection is frozen into every brief; no extension adds a model tool or changes a prompt.

preflight_policy.description: Admission limits checked before a batch is created. Oversized work must be split before any model dispatch.

capabilities.description: Capabilities this profile can satisfy; credentials are never stored here.

agent.description: Orca agent identifier selected by this project-owned profile.

write_paths.description: Optional narrower write boundary for this role. It must remain inside the assigned zone.

transport.description: How this role is executed: an explicitly selected Orca-dispatched isolated worker, or an in-process subagent of the coordinator session. Both consume the same immutable brief and must pass the model self-report.

default_runtime.description: Project-owned default used only when this role declares more than one runtime. Without it callers must pass --runtime.

runtimes.description: Named runtime assignments, such as codex or claude.
